parameters.query:
=SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) AS results
FROM (
  SELECT id, category, question, answer, question_ar, answer_ar
  FROM knowledge_base
  WHERE is_active = TRUE
    AND (
      question ILIKE '%{{ ($json.customer_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}%'
      OR answer ILIKE '%{{ ($json.customer_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}%'
      OR question_ar ILIKE '%{{ ($json.customer_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}%'
      OR answer_ar ILIKE '%{{ ($json.customer_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}%'
      OR '{{ ($json.customer_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' ILIKE ANY(SELECT '%' || unnest(keywords) || '%')
      OR '{{ ($json.customer_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' ILIKE ANY(SELECT '%' || unnest(keywords_ar) || '%')
    )
  ORDER BY id ASC
  LIMIT 2
) t;
